descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，查询当前阿里云账号`100931896542****`中资源的监控范围。返回结果显示，资源监控类型为`ACS::ECS::Instance`和`ACS::ECS::NetworkInterface`，资源监控状态为`REGISTERED`（已注册）。
descriptions.en: In this example, the Alibaba Cloud account `100931896542****` is used. The return result shows that two types of resources are monitored: `ACS::ECS::Instance` and `ACS::ECS::NetworkInterface`. The status of the configuration recorder is `REGISTERED`.
